memory_candidates: NF transfer depth gap: nf_extend_fwd maps depth-(K+1) r-var agreement to depth-K (r+1)-var agreement, losing one depth level. For existPart_succ_n1_bypass at k>0 (Until/Since zones), the chain starting from depth-(k'+2) 1-var agreement reaches depth-k' 3-var agreement — one level short of the depth-(k'+1) 3-var evaluation needed for sub_nf.2. This gap propagates through k'+1 levels of recursion and cannot be closed with monotonicity (downward only) or exist_transfer_const_env (requires one more depth level).

ExistPart constant-parent architectural limitation: ExistPart uses env (fun _ => t), meaning all non-first variables equal t. Until zone needs [y, x, t] where x != t. The eq zone (x = t) works because [y, t, t] = Fin.cons y (fun _ => t) IS constant-parent. Resolution requires either: (A) parameterize ExistPart by parent NF types, (B) prove Feferman-Vaught composition for monadic linear orders, or (C) direct depth-recursive formula construction.
